title: Learning Module — Reading Instructions and Safety Labels

meta.audience: A learner or a small group at the lesson's site, with a GRIOT character as the guide.
meta.why: One K-12 station taught as a lesson: its own study card, the station, one check question, and a simpler re-teach step when the check is missed, then back to the check.
meta.hostNotes: The SmartCiti.X side of the flow contract only (docs/flowhub.md): generated by tools/gen_cg_units.mjs from the station's own steps and check; nothing here states how Cognition.X or any other host stores or presents it.
meta.lowConnectivity: Works offline once the page has loaded; the run waits in this browser's own storage.

nodes.title: Pre-brief — Reading Instructions and Safety Labels
nodes.why: The station's own study card, read first.

nodes.title: Reading Instructions and Safety Labels
nodes.why: The K-12 station itself; a run that does not pass goes back to the brief.

nodes.title: Check question — Reading Instructions and Safety Labels
nodes.why: One question on the idea just taught. A missed answer goes to a simpler re-teach step, then back here. Never scored against anyone.

check.q: Where do you look first on a safety sign?
options: The signal word at the top
check.why: The signal word tells you how serious it is before anything else.

nodes.title: Re-teach — Reading Instructions and Safety Labels, one step at a time
nodes.why: The adaptive step: the same idea in the station's own short step titles, then back to the check.

reteach: Find the parts of the label.
Read the instructions all the way through.
Put the reading routine in order.

nodes.title: End-of-lesson check-in
nodes.why: The lesson closes on the learner's own answer about how it went, not on a score.
